// dir: x
// want: x: params are used outside a reader call: ctx.Params("file-size")
// want: x: params are used outside a reader call: shared
// with: pass
package x

import "github.com/0b1-PulsarTech/pulsarules_codex/internal/analyzer/pass"

var shared pass.ParamSet

func set(ctx pass.Context) { shared = ctx.Params("file-size") }

func limit() int { return shared.Int("max_lines", 0) }
